items.title: 和成受惠軍工題材、無人機通過政院副署 法人估2027軍工營收比重有望提升逾15％
items.title_en: He Cheng Benefits from Military-Industrial Theme, Drone Legislation Signed by Executive Yuan Deputy; Institutional Estimates 2027 Military-Industrial Revenue Share Could Rise Over 15%
paras: 玻陶廠和成(1810-TW)受房地產市場近年低迷影響，公司持續開拓布局軍工有成，也研發複合材料事業，不僅切入國防領域的防彈裝甲車，也卡位無人載具領域。法人報告指出，和成明(2027)年將增加無人機載具貢獻，估明年軍工營收比重有望由今年10％比重提升至15％。
和成8月營收3.43億元、月減11.66％、年增4.61%，低於法人預期，主因軍工產品如抗彈板、無人機載具等出貨動能未達預期所致。公司預計下半年在軍工產品出貨，看好今年營運有望優於去年表現。
法人報告指出，和成因今(2026)年因浴設備貢獻估持平去(2025)年，但持續增添無人機載具貢獻，預估今年軍工營收比重約10％，明(2027)年軍工營收比重有望提升至逾15％，加上本業有望較今年微幅成長，加上目前股價基期偏低，給予投資買進建議。
此外，行政院長卓榮泰上周已正式簽署副署立法院版無人機條例 ，雖非行政院版本，但考量國防安全與產業升級已副署後，對和成未來軍工發展，業績有望呈現利多想像空間。
和成目前集團旗下複合材料事業產品，則因陶瓷材料擁有高硬度特色，加上採用碳纖維材質，具備輕量化優勢，已成功通過國防部驗證，應用在國防、無人載具等領域，包括近2年來政府正積極推動國艦國造、國機國造，看好未來相關國防軍工的發展潛力。
paras_en: He Cheng (1810-TW), a glass-ceramic manufacturer, has been affected by the recent real‑estate market slump but continues to expand into the defense sector and develop composite‑material businesses. It has entered the defense market with bullet‑proof armored vehicles and is positioning itself in the unmanned vehicle field. Institutional reports note that He Cheng’s contribution from drone platforms will increase in 2027, and the share of military‑industrial revenue is expected to rise from about 10% this year to roughly 15% next year.

In August, He Cheng posted revenue of NT$343 million, down 11.66% month‑over‑month but up 4.61% year‑over‑year, missing analysts’ expectations. The shortfall was mainly due to weaker than expected shipments of military‑industrial products such as anti‑ballistic plates and drone platforms. The company expects stronger shipments of these items in the second half of the year and believes its 2024 performance can surpass that of 2023.

The institutional report states that He Cheng’s revenue from bath‑equipment in 2026 is projected to be flat versus 2025, while contributions from drone platforms will continue to grow. It estimates the military‑industrial revenue share at about 10% this year and expects it to exceed 15% in 2027, with modest growth in its core business. Given the current low base price of the stock, the report recommends a buy.

Last week, Executive Yuan Premier Chuo Jung‑tai formally signed a deputy version of the Legislative Yuan’s drone regulations. Although it is not the Executive Yuan’s own version, the deputy enactment—considering national defense security and industry upgrading—should be positive for He Cheng’s future military‑industrial development and could boost its earnings outlook.

He Cheng’s composite‑material division offers products that combine high‑hardness ceramic with carbon‑fiber reinforcement, providing lightweight advantages. These products have passed Ministry of National Defense verification and are used in defense and unmanned‑vehicle applications. With the government actively promoting domestic shipbuilding and aircraft manufacturing over the past two years, the company sees strong potential for growth in related defense and military‑industrial sectors.

items.title: 〈熱門股〉萊德光電-KY受惠衛星、光纖雙引擎驅動  周漲15％站回500元大關
items.title_en: <Hot Stock> Lidar Optoelectronics-KY Benefits from Dual Engines of Satellites and Fiber Optics, Rises 15% This Week to Reclaim the 500 NT$ Threshold
paras: 光纖元件廠萊德光電-KY(7717-TW)受惠於低軌衛星、光纖元件出貨強勁，8月營收月增12.44%、年增86.19%，創歷史單月次高，激勵上周股價周漲15.02％，周K連收3紅，不僅重新站回500元大關，也攻上中短期均線之上，顯示多方力道強勁。
台股上周於中東局勢再掀波瀾下，推升布蘭特原油期貨(BRENT)一度上揚超過100美元，在通膨壓力、美債殖利率居高不下，電子股表現疲軟，周K翻黑，單周成交量更縮減近兆元，萊德光電-KY卻逆勢上漲15.02％，周成交量也爆增近6,000張。
萊德光電-KY因看準太空低軌衛星經濟商機，公司持續積極切入衛星雷射通訊應用，也將長線發展延伸至太空AI資料中心、太空發電站及太空製造等光纖傳輸領域，公司表示，未來有機會將持續布局低軌衛星的雷射通訊系統。
此外，近期SpaceX(SPCX-US)透露，正專注於透過可重複使用的火箭和衛星技術降低成本，未來發展Starship(星鏈)為公司的核心，不僅支撐衛星寬頻服務，也為未來的軌道運算與地面資料中心營利奠定基礎，希望突破地面資料中心面臨的電力供應、散熱等限制。
法人指出，隨著太空經濟持續發展，AI資料中心進入太空發展可行性，未來也有望帶動相關低軌衛星供應鏈持續發展。
paras_en: Fiber component maker Lidar Optoelectronics-KY (7717-TW) is benefiting from strong shipments of low‑orbit satellites and fiber components. In August its revenue grew 12.44% month‑over‑month and 86.19% year‑over‑year, the second‑highest monthly figure in its history, which spurred a 15.02% weekly price gain. The stock posted three consecutive red‑candles on the weekly chart, reclaimed the 500‑NT$ level and moved above its medium‑term moving averages, indicating robust buying pressure.

Last week the Taiwan market was rattled by renewed Middle‑East tensions, pushing Brent crude futures up more than US$100 at one point. With inflation pressures and U.S. Treasury yields remaining high, electronics stocks were weak, the weekly chart turned negative and weekly turnover shrank by nearly a trillion NT$, yet Lidar Optoelectronics‑KY bucked the trend, climbing 15.02% and seeing its weekly volume surge by about 6,000 lots.

Lidar Optoelectronics‑KY sees a long‑term opportunity in the low‑orbit satellite economy. The company is actively entering the satellite laser‑communication market and is extending its development roadmap to include space‑based AI data centers, orbital power stations and space manufacturing that rely on fiber transmission. It says it may continue to build out laser‑communication systems for low‑orbit satellites in the future.

In addition, SpaceX (SPCX‑US) recently disclosed that it is focusing on reducing costs through reusable rockets and satellite technology, with the Starship (Starlink) program becoming its core. This not only underpins satellite broadband services but also lays the groundwork for profitable orbital computing and ground‑based data‑center operations, aiming to overcome ground‑center constraints such as power supply and heat dissipation.
Analysts note that as the space economy matures, the feasibility of AI data centers in orbit improves, which could further drive growth across the low‑orbit satellite supply chain.

items.title: 〈台股風向球〉資金續航力先看台幣 提防「升息周期到來」的預期形成
items.title_en: Taiwan Stock Market Outlook: Watch the New Taiwan Dollar's Funding Strength and Guard Against Expectations of an "Interest‑Rate‑Hike Cycle"
paras: 台股過去一周下跌366.28點，多方守住4萬6及月線支撐，隨著美股周五反彈反映國際油價回跌，本周開局的升息恐慌壓力緩解，不過，台股交易員提醒，美國聯準會本周升息機率已超過80%，新台幣若轉弱恐不利資金行情續航，再加上中東政治局勢複雜令油價高度波動，仍須留意系統性風險升溫。此外台積電(2330-TW)將於周三(16日) 進行除息，每股配發現金股利 7元，美國聯準會與台灣央行預計周四(17日) 同日公布最新利率決策，也成為市場關注的焦點。
台股上周終結周線連2紅，儘管跌幅僅0.79%，但除了投信不離不棄，外資和自營商均站在賣超，使籌碼面有壓。
觀察外資上周主要賣超仁寶(2324-TW)達9.8萬張，緯創(3231-TW)8萬張，元大台灣50反1(00632R-TW)近7萬張，台新新光金(2887-TW)超過5.8萬張，元大台灣50正2(00631L-TW)超過4萬張，主動中信台灣收益(00406A-TW)近3.8萬張，群益台灣精選高息(00919-TW)3萬張。
台股交易員表示，CME FedWatch 顯示本周聯準會升息 1 碼的機率已達86%，但美股周五並未明顯反映升息恐慌壓力是因油價回落，部分市場聲浪更認為美國通膨數據尚不足以支撐升息。
因此，本周須留意國際油價的波動大，一旦美國升息並造成市場預期「升息周期已到來」，恐使大盤整體資金回流美元，並造成一波短線的拉回壓力。
永豐投顧分析，台股歷史高原區47000點左右均線糾結，在上周五跌破後要看本周是否可以成功收復，以及量能是否放大，量能若是持續縮小到6000億元，整體市場資金不足，則後續要重新站回關卡需要更多利多推動。
永豐投顧也提醒，市場將開始關注油價影響物價是否已開始形成長期化。
paras_en: The Taiwan market fell 366.28 points last week, with bulls holding the 46,000 level and the monthly moving‑average support. As U.S. equities rebounded on Friday, reflecting a pull‑back in global oil prices, the interest‑rate‑hike panic at the start of this week eased. However, traders warned that the Fed’s probability of raising rates this week has now exceeded 80%; a weakening New Taiwan dollar could hurt the market’s funding stamina. In addition, the complex political situation in the Middle East keeps oil prices highly volatile, raising systemic‑risk concerns. TSMC (2330‑TW) will declare a cash dividend of NT$7 per share on Wednesday (the 16th), and the Fed and Taiwan’s central bank are expected to announce their latest rate decisions on Thursday (the 17th), which will also draw market focus.

Last week the Taiwan market ended a two‑week streak of weekly gains; despite a modest 0.79% decline, institutional investors remained supportive while foreign investors and proprietary traders were net sellers, putting pressure on the chip count.

Foreign investors’ major net‑selling last week included 98,000 shares of Compal (2324‑TW), 80,000 shares of Wistron (3231‑TW), nearly 70,000 shares of Yuanta Taiwan 50 Reverse 1 (00632R‑TW), over 58,000 shares of Taishin Shin Kong Financial (2887‑TW), more than 40,000 shares of Yuanta Taiwan 50 Forward 2 (00631L‑TW), about 38,000 shares of Active CTBC Taiwan Yield (00406A‑TW) and 30,000 shares of Qunyi Taiwan Selected High‑Yield (00919‑TW).

A Taiwan market trader noted that the CME FedWatch tool shows an 86% chance of a one‑point Fed hike this week, but Friday’s U.S. market did not reflect strong hike‑fear pressure because oil prices fell, and some market voices argue that U.S. inflation data are still insufficient to justify another hike.

Therefore, this week investors should watch for large swings in international oil prices. If the Fed does raise rates and the market perceives that the “rate‑hike cycle has arrived,” capital could flow back to the dollar, creating short‑term pull‑back pressure on the broader index.

Yongfeng Investment Advisory points out that the Taiwan market’s historic plateau around the 47,000‑point moving‑average band has been tangled; after breaking below it last Friday, the key question is whether the market can reclaim the level this week and whether volume expands. If volume continues to shrink to NT$600 billion, overall market liquidity will be thin, and a further rally will need additional positive catalysts.
Yongfeng also cautioned that the market will start watching whether oil‑price‑driven inflation is beginning to become entrenched over the long term.

items.title: imec突破High-NA EUV極限 光阻材料將一路延續至埃米世代
items.title_en: imec Breaks High-NA EUV Limits; Photoresist Materials Expected to Continue Through the A-Series Nodes
paras: 比利時微電子研究中心(imec)宣布攜手ASML及材料供應商，在High-NA EUV微影技術再取得進展。將產業沿用多年的化學放大阻劑(CAR)，完成22奈米間距導線的單次圖形化，並驗證多種接近實際晶片設計的複雜結構，顯示成熟CAR光阻技術有望延伸至A14、A10等埃米世代，應用於部分關鍵金屬層與通孔層。
隨著先進製程持續微縮，傳統0.33NA EUV在部分高密度層已逐步逼近單次曝光極限，未來若要製作更細線路，可能需要透過多重圖形化增加曝光與蝕刻次數。High-NA EUV則藉由提高數值孔徑，提升解析能力，目標是在更小尺寸下仍可維持單次曝光，降低製程複雜度及多次曝光帶來的對位誤差。
不過，曝光機解析度提升後，光阻材料是否能同步支援更細微圖形，一直是High-NA EUV量產的重要挑戰。化學放大阻劑是目前半導體業長期使用的成熟技術，具備穩定度高、供應鏈完整與量產經驗豐富等優勢，但過去業界普遍關注，其在極小尺寸下是否會面臨圖形粗糙、斷線或橋接等問題。
imec此次公布的成果顯示，經過材料與蝕刻製程共同優化後，CAR的微縮能力仍有進一步延伸空間。imec已利用High-NA EUV單次曝光，成功完成22奈米導線/間距圖形，較先前驗證的28奈米間距再進一步縮小。
除了規則性線路外，imec此次也將測試範圍擴展到更貼近實際邏輯晶片的複雜圖形，包括蛇形與叉形電性測試結構、SRAM布局、邏輯金屬佈線，以及28奈米中心間距的通孔結構，並取得良好的圖形保真度。
imec指出，相關成果顯示High-NA EUV搭配CAR，有機會應用在A14、A10邏輯節點的部分關鍵元件層，包括第二金屬層(M2)、通孔層，以及連接電晶體源極、汲極與第一金屬層的金屬擴散層。
事實上，imec先前已透過電性測試，驗證High-NA EUV搭配CAR可製作28奈米間距金屬線，並在長達1.8公尺的金屬化測試結構上取得具發展潛力的組合良率，證明相關技術不只停留在圖形成像階段，也具備進一步朝電性與量產驗證推進的潛力。
此次進一步將間距縮小至22奈米，也代表CAR突破過去0.33NA EUV單次圖形化被認為存在的微縮極限。相較全面更換新型光阻材料，若現有CAR平台可持續沿用，將有助降低High-NA EUV導入新材料與新製程的複雜度，並延續既有成熟供應鏈。
imec圖形化技術研究計畫研發副總Geert Vandenberghe表示，CAR是半導體產業沿用數十年的成熟技術，穩定性及可製造性均已經過長期驗證，最新研究結果顯示，CAR在High-NA EUV時代仍具有相當大的應用價值。
從產業角度來看，High-NA EUV真正的效益不僅在於能夠印出更小尺寸圖形，更在於有機會將原本需要兩次甚至多次曝光的關鍵製程，重新整合為單次圖形化。若能減少曝光、蝕刻與對位次數，可望降低製程複雜度與overlay誤差，並改善先進製程的製造效率。
paras_en: Belgian research institute imec announced a collaboration with ASML and material suppliers to achieve another milestone in High-NA EUV lithography, using the industry‑standard chemically amplified resist (CAR) to print 22 nm pitch lines in a single exposure and to validate a variety of complex structures that resemble real chip designs, indicating that mature CAR technology could extend to A14, A10 and other A‑series nodes for selected critical metal and via layers.

As advanced processes keep shrinking, conventional 0.33 NA EUV is approaching its single‑exposure limit on some high‑density layers, and future finer lines may require multiple patterning steps that increase exposure and etch cycles. High‑NA EUV raises the numerical aperture to improve resolution, aiming to keep single‑exposure printing at smaller dimensions, thereby reducing process complexity and alignment errors associated with multiple exposures.

However, once the scanner’s resolution is enhanced, whether the photoresist can keep up with finer patterns remains a key challenge for High‑NA EUV volume production. Chemically amplified resists are a long‑standing, mature technology in the semiconductor industry, offering high stability, a complete supply chain and extensive production experience, but the industry has traditionally worried about potential issues such as line roughness, breaks or bridges at extremely small dimensions.

imec’s new results show that, after co‑optimizing the resist and etch processes, CAR still has room to shrink further. Using High‑NA EUV single‑exposure, imec successfully printed 22 nm line/space patterns, a step beyond the previously demonstrated 28 nm pitch.

Beyond regular lines, imec also expanded testing to more realistic logic‑chip geometries, including serpentine and forked electrical test structures, SRAM layouts, logic metal routing, and 28 nm center‑to‑center via patterns, all of which achieved good pattern fidelity.

imec notes that these findings suggest High‑NA EUV combined with CAR could be used for key layers of the A14 and A10 logic nodes, such as the second metal layer (M2), via layers, and the metal diffusion layer that connects transistor source/drain to the first metal layer.

In fact, imec previously demonstrated through electrical testing that High‑NA EUV with CAR can fabricate 28 nm pitch metal lines and achieved promising combination yields on a 1.8‑meter‑long metallization test structure, proving the technology is moving beyond imaging to electrical and production validation.

Shrinking the pitch further to 22 nm this time shows that CAR can break the perceived shrink limit of 0.33 NA EUV single‑patterning. If the existing CAR platform can continue to be used instead of switching to entirely new resists, it will lower the complexity of introducing new materials and processes for High‑NA EUV while preserving the mature supply chain.

Geert Vandenberghe, vice‑president of imec’s lithography research program, said CAR has been a proven, decades‑old technology in the semiconductor industry, with stability and manufacturability validated over time, and the latest results demonstrate that CAR still holds significant value in the High‑NA EUV era.

From an industry perspective, the real benefit of High‑NA EUV lies not only in printing smaller features but also in the possibility of consolidating processes that previously required two or more exposures into a single patterning step. Reducing the number of exposures, etches and alignments can cut process complexity and overlay errors, improving manufacturing efficiency for advanced nodes.

items.title: 維田樂看市況能見度維持高檔 營運淡季不淡、旺季更旺
items.title_en: WeiTian Remains Optimistic as Market Visibility Stays High; Off‑Season Not Slow, Peak Season Even Stronger
paras: 工業電腦廠維田(6570-TW)表示，受惠Edge AI需求升溫、歐美專案拉貨力道強勁，對市況維持樂觀看法，下半年營運可望逐季增，淡季不淡、旺季更旺，預期全年營收挑戰新高、獲利也將重回成長。
維田表示，從目前需求來看，Edge AI相關領域的接單情況十分不錯，而智慧交通、智慧醫療等大型專案持續按照排程出貨，加上歐美市場訂單量、出貨量維持穩定，整體訂單能見度仍相當高。
維田進一步指出，公司近年布局高毛利產品，尤以不鏽鋼工業電腦產品線的成效最佳，毛利率貢獻高，產品銷售量也呈現穩定成長，公司對不鏽鋼產品線深具信心，對營運表現有非常大的助益。
維田NuTAM系列不鏽鋼工業電腦，具備IP66/IP69K整機防水防塵，抗紫外線日光可視觸控螢幕，可在寬溫嚴苛環境操作，具有Edge AI運算能力，適合食品製造、生技製藥、戶外場域等應用，
維田8月營收月1.04億元，雖然月減2.9%、但年增22.6%，累計前8月營收7.61億元，年增27.5%，創歷史同期新高。
paras_en: Industrial computer maker WeiTian (6570‑TW) said that rising demand for Edge AI and strong order pull from Europe and the United States keep its market outlook upbeat. It expects quarterly revenue growth in the second half, with the off‑season remaining robust and the peak season even stronger, targeting a new‑high full‑year revenue and a return to profit growth.

WeiTian noted that current demand for Edge AI‑related fields is very strong, and large projects in smart transportation and smart healthcare continue to ship on schedule. Combined with stable order and shipment volumes in Europe and the United States, overall order visibility remains high.

The company further pointed out that it has recently focused on high‑margin products, especially its stainless‑steel industrial computer line, which delivers the best gross‑margin contribution and shows steady sales growth. WeiTian is highly confident in the stainless‑steel line, which greatly supports its operating performance.

WeiTian’s NuTAM series stainless‑steel industrial computers feature IP66/IP69K full‑machine waterproof and dustproof protection, UV‑resistant sunlight‑visible touch screens, and can operate in wide‑temperature harsh environments. They also have Edge AI computing capability, making them suitable for food manufacturing, biotech/pharma, outdoor applications and more.

WeiTian posted August revenue of NT$104 million, down 2.9% month‑over‑month but up 22.6% year‑over‑year. Cumulative revenue for the first eight months reached NT$761 million, a 27.5% year‑over‑year increase, setting a new historical high for the same period.

items.title: 百容購新廠建地本周完成交割 仍往需求強烈半導體應用擴張
items.title_en: BaiRong Completes New Factory Land Transfer This Week, Continues Strong Demand for Semiconductor Applications Expansion
paras: 百容 (2483-TW)擲3.23 億元購置台中工業區工一路702坪廠房及土地，預計在本周完成交割，這也是今年以來繼大立光 (3008-TW) 在台中工業區的提供生產用生產用不動產購置案。百容規劃將爲生產CPU散熱片生產新產能。
百容投資台中廠二期工程已經進入完工階段，二廠並並設置新研發中心；購置台中工業區新廠土地面積達 702 坪，預計將另投入資金購買設備及另重新與建廠房容納重型沖壓設備進駐，對於資金需求規劃，百容評估仍以有資金支應，目前暫無自市場進行籌資的規劃。
百容 2026 年第二季單季營收達 5.66 億元，創同期新高，季增 17.62%，年增 20.42%，同時，在百容第二季在毛利率及營業利益同步走高，加上業外及匯率等有利因素挹注，百容所獲挹注上半年稅後純益將逾 4362萬元，每股純益達 0.4元。
百容 2026 年 7 月營收 2.01 億元，月增 1.75%，年增 37.19%，8月也在1.88億元的歷史高檔水準，且在產品結構上，對半導體應用業務仍維持於50%之上的水準；預估2026年第三季仍將維持第二季的營收水準 。
百容產品涵蓋半導體應用業業、電子零組件、步進馬達等，2026年以來半導體應用業務己登上營收50%之上，同時，對繼電器也朝耐高壓、大電流產品發展。
paras_en: BaiRong (2483-TW) spent NT$323 million to acquire a 702-ping factory and land on Gongyi Road in the Taichung Industrial Zone, with the transfer expected to be completed this week. This follows Largan Precision (3008-TW)’s acquisition of production‑use real estate in the same zone earlier this year. BaiRong plans to use the site to add new capacity for manufacturing CPU heat sinks.

The second‑phase project for BaiRong’s Taichung plant has entered the completion stage and will also house a new R&D center. The newly purchased land totals 702 ping, and the company intends to invest further funds to buy equipment and construct facilities capable of accommodating heavy‑press machines. Regarding financing, BaiRong assesses that it has sufficient internal funds and currently has no plans to raise capital from the market.

In Q2 2026, BaiRong recorded quarterly revenue of NT$566 million, a record high for the period, up 17.62% quarter‑over‑quarter and 20.42% year‑over‑year. Gross margin and operating profit both improved, and favorable non‑operating and exchange‑rate effects boosted the results. The company’s net profit after tax for the first half of the year is projected to exceed NT$43.62 million, or earnings of NT$0.40 per share.

In July 2026, BaiRong’s revenue reached NT$201 million, up 1.75% month‑over‑month and 37.19% year‑over‑year. August revenue remained at a historic high of NT$188 million, and the semiconductor‑application segment continues to account for over 50% of sales. The company expects Q3 2026 revenue to stay at the same level as Q2.

BaiRong’s product portfolio includes semiconductor‑application components, electronic parts, and stepper motors. Since 2026, semiconductor‑application sales have exceeded 50% of total revenue, and the firm is also expanding its relay business toward high‑voltage, high‑current products.

items.title: 中東戰火升溫油價飆破115美元！中油淚吞近2百億 明起汽、柴油各漲0.7元及0.6元
items.title_en: Middle East conflict heats up, oil prices surge past $115! CPC Corp swallows nearly NT$20 billion, gasoline and diesel to rise NT$0.7 and NT$0.6 starting tomorrow
paras: 中東地緣政治危機加劇，國際油價飆漲，即令台灣中油公司近7個月來已吞下近200億補貼，但仍擋不住漲勢。 台灣中油12日宣布，自明（14）日凌晨0時起至9月20日24時止，汽、柴油價格每公升將分別調漲0.7元及0.6元。調整後的參考零售價格分別為92無鉛汽油每公升31.2元、95無鉛汽油每公升32.7元、98無鉛汽油每公升34.7元、超級柴油每公升29.9元。
隨著中東戰事持續升溫，市場對原油供應與運輸風險的疑慮大幅增加，帶動國際油價急遽攀升。台灣中油表示，本周浮動油價調整指標7D3B（70%杜拜+30%北海布蘭特）周均價攀升至每桶115.61美元，較前周的99.82美元大漲15.79美元；雖然新台幣對美元匯率升值0.126元，但綜合評估後，依油價公式計算漲幅仍高達12.29%。

為照顧國內民生與平穩物價，政府及台灣中油持續啟動各項平穩機制。除了政府擴大貨物稅減徵，汽、柴油分別吸收3.7元及2.1元外，台灣中油為維持亞鄰最低價並持續執行美伊戰爭專案平穩機制，本周汽、柴油各再吸收6.8元及8.7元。合計汽、柴油每公升分別吸收高達10.5元及10.8元，大幅緩解國內物價通膨壓力。台灣中油統計，自今年2月28日至9月13日止，執行專案平穩各項措施累計吸收金額已達約198.5億元。
paras_en: The escalating geopolitical crisis in the Middle East has driven international oil prices sharply higher, forcing Taiwan’s CPC Corp to absorb nearly NT$20 billion in subsidies over the past seven months, yet it cannot stop the upward trend. CPC announced on the 12th that, effective from 00:00 on the 14th until 24:00 on September 20, gasoline and diesel prices will each increase by NT$0.7 and NT$0.6 per litre, respectively. After the adjustment, the reference retail prices will be NT$31.2 per litre for 92‑octane unleaded gasoline, NT$32.7 for 95‑octane, NT$34.7 for 98‑octane, and NT$29.9 for premium diesel.

As the Middle East war intensifies, market concerns over crude supply and transportation risks have surged, pushing international oil prices sharply upward. CPC reported that this week’s floating oil price adjustment index 7D3B (70% Dubai + 30% Brent) rose to a weekly average of $115.61 per barrel, up $15.79 from the previous week’s $99.82. Although the New Taiwan dollar appreciated by NT$0.126 against the US dollar, the calculated price increase based on the oil‑price formula still reaches 12.29%.

To protect domestic livelihoods and stabilize prices, the government and CPC continue to activate various stabilization mechanisms. In addition to the government’s expanded reduction of commodity taxes, CPC absorbs NT$3.7 per litre of gasoline and NT$2.1 per litre of diesel. Moreover, to maintain the lowest regional price and continue the US‑Iran war stabilization project, CPC absorbs an additional NT$6.8 per litre of gasoline and NT$8.7 per litre of diesel this week. In total, CPC absorbs up to NT$10.5 per litre of gasoline and NT$10.8 per litre of diesel, markedly easing domestic inflation pressure. CPC’s statistics show that from February 28 to September 13 this year, the cumulative amount absorbed through the stabilization measures totals approximately NT$19.85 billion.

items.title: 股市能安然度過Fed升息？華爾街看好AI獲利成長：未必重演過去跌勢
items.title_en: Can the Stock Market Safely Weather Fed Rate Hikes? Wall Street Optimistic About AI Profit Growth: A Repeat of Past Declines Is Not Inevitable
paras: 投資人通常視升息為股市利空，但華爾街部分專家認為，投資人其實不必過度焦慮，即使聯準會（Fed）今年剩餘時間再次升息，股市也未必會重演過去幾輪升息週期的跌勢。
根據《Business Insider》報導，關鍵在於，AI投資熱潮仍推動企業獲利高速成長，加上通膨逐步降溫，若聯準會採取緩步升息策略，股市可能具備足夠韌性消化利率變化。
市場目前已高度預期聯準會將在2026年剩餘期間至少升息一次。根據芝商所FedWatch工具，截至週五（11日），市場押注聯準會下週9月會議升息的機率達87%；而到12月會議時，聯準會至少升息兩次的機率為63.5%。
調控短期利率是央行用來放緩或刺激經濟活動的工具之一，讓聯準會得以對抗通膨或支持就業成長。近幾個月通膨仍具有黏性，7月年增率為3.4%，因此投資人預期聯準會將調高利率，以抑制持續上升的消費者價格。
歷史經驗顯示，升息通常對股市構成壓力。LPL Financial統計，自1994年以來，標普500指數在每輪升息週期首次升息後的6個月平均呈現負報酬。
2022年的經驗更讓投資人記憶猶新。當時聯準會在數個月內將聯邦基金利率從接近零一路拉升至5%以上，標普500指數全年重挫20%。
不過，華爾街人士認為，這一次的市場環境與2022年存在明顯差異，升息本身未必代表股市將大幅回落。
Sterling Capital Management客戶投資組合經理Whitney Stewart指出，目前股市的一項重要支撐來自超大規模雲端業者持續投入大量資金發展AI，進而帶動企業獲利維持強勁成長。
Stewart表示，市場目前預期標普500指數成分股2027年獲利將維持雙位數成長。他指出，只要AI支出的前景維持不變，就應足以抵銷升息可能帶來的樂觀情緒降溫。
LPL在報告中也提出類似觀點。該公司將當前環境與1997年相提並論，當時儘管聯準會升息，標普500指數仍持續強勁上漲，因為投資人對網際網路發展仍抱持樂觀態度。
除了AI帶來的獲利支撐，通膨走勢也可能成為股市的另一項緩衝因素。目前通膨雖然仍具有黏性，但已從5月4.2%的高點回落。
市場認為，只要通膨持續緩步降溫，聯準會就不必採取過於激進的升息步調，讓投資人有更多時間消化利率政策變化。
Charles Schwab宏觀研究與策略主管Kevin Gordon近日在給客戶的報告中表示，過去當聯準會啟動緩慢的緊縮週期時，標普500指數在接下來一年平均上漲10.5%。相較之下，當緊縮週期進展快速時，股市在隨後12個月平均下跌3.6%。
Gordon表示：「如果聯準會採取電梯式反應，也就是以小幅度逐步升息，可能每隔一次會議升息一次，那麼股市應該能夠消化這個相對緩慢的緊縮過程。」
除了升息速度之外，聯準會究竟需要升息多少次，同樣是影響股市的重要因素。2022年，聯準會當時正對抗一度升破9%的通膨，但目前聯準會不太可能需要像當時一樣進行如此多次升息，因此即使股市出現回落，跌幅也可能不會像當時那麼嚴重。
Glenmede投資策略副總裁Mike Reynolds表示：「聯準會現在某種程度上是在處理通膨最後一點殘餘壓力。」
Reynolds表示，升息後股市可能重新定價，但如果聯準會決定升息，「以我的基本情境來看，我不預期會出現類似2022年的大幅、持續性跌勢。」
paras_en: Investors usually view rate hikes as a bearish signal for equities, but some Wall Street experts say investors need not be overly anxious; even if the Federal Reserve raises rates again during the remainder of this year, the market may not repeat the declines seen in previous tightening cycles.

According to Business Insider, the key is that the AI investment boom continues to drive rapid corporate profit growth, and with inflation gradually cooling, a gradual Fed tightening could give the market enough resilience to absorb interest‑rate changes.

The market is already pricing in at least one more Fed hike before the end of 2026. CME’s FedWatch tool showed that as of Friday the 11th, the probability of a rate increase at the September meeting was 87%, and by the December meeting the odds of at least two hikes rose to 63.5%.

Adjusting short‑term rates is one of the central bank’s tools to slow or stimulate economic activity, allowing the Fed to combat inflation or support job growth. Inflation has remained sticky in recent months, with a 3.4% year‑over‑year rate in July, leading investors to expect higher rates to curb rising consumer prices.

Historical experience shows rate hikes usually put pressure on stocks. LPL Financial’s data indicate that since 1994 the S&P 500 has posted an average negative return in the six months following the first hike of each tightening cycle.
The 2022 episode remains fresh in investors’ minds. That year the Fed lifted the federal‑funds rate from near zero to above 5% over several months, and the S&P 500 fell about 20% for the year.
Nevertheless, Wall Street commentators argue that today’s environment differs markedly from 2022, and a rate hike does not automatically translate into a sharp market pullback.

Whitney Stewart, portfolio manager for Sterling Capital Management clients, says a major support for equities now comes from mega‑scale cloud providers pouring capital into AI development, which sustains strong corporate earnings growth.

Stewart notes that the market currently expects S&P 500 constituents to deliver double‑digit earnings growth through 2027. He adds that as long as AI spending outlook remains intact, it should offset any cooling of optimism caused by rate hikes.
LPL’s report echoes this view, likening the current backdrop to 1997 when, despite Fed tightening, the S&P 500 kept climbing because investors remained upbeat about the internet’s growth potential.
Beyond AI‑driven earnings, the inflation trajectory could also act as a buffer for equities. Although inflation is still sticky, it has retreated from a May peak of 4.2%.
The market believes that if inflation continues to ease gradually, the Fed won’t need to pursue an overly aggressive tightening path, giving investors more time to digest policy shifts.

Kevin Gordon, head of macro research and strategy at Charles Schwab, wrote in a client note that historically, when the Fed embarked on a slow‑moving tightening cycle, the S&P 500 rose an average of 10.5% over the following year, whereas fast‑pace tightening saw the index fall an average of 3.6% in the next 12 months.
Gordon said, “If the Fed takes an ‘elevator‑type’ approach—small, incremental hikes, perhaps every other meeting—equities should be able to absorb this relatively modest tightening process.”

Besides the pace, the total number of hikes the Fed needs to deliver also matters for stocks. In 2022 the Fed was battling inflation that had briefly topped 9%, but such a series of hikes is unlikely now, so any market pullback would probably be less severe than in 2022.
Mike Reynolds, vice‑president of investment strategy at Glenmede, said, “The Fed is now, to some extent, dealing with the last bits of residual inflation pressure.”
Reynolds added that while equities may reprice after hikes, if the Fed does raise rates, “based on my baseline scenario, I don’t expect a large, sustained decline like we saw in 2022.”

items.title: 美債殖利率逼近5%仍非股市「殺手」？經濟學家：並非經濟過熱
items.title_en: U.S. Treasury Yields Near 5% Still Not a Stock Market ‘Killer’? Economist Says It’s Not Overheating the Economy
paras: 美國公債殖利率持續攀升，已升至通常會對股市構成壓力的水準，但截至目前仍未扭轉美股多頭格局。TS Lombard經濟學家認為，近期殖利率上揚的原因與過去足以終結多頭行情的經濟過熱並不相同，因此目前還不足以成為股市的致命威脅。
根據《Business Insider》報導，基準10年期美債殖利率週五（11日）升至4.96%，反映債券市場持續遭遇拋售。
這波美債賣壓已延續數月，背後因素包括油價走高、通膨黏著、政府大量舉債，以及市場預期聯準會（Fed）將在更長時間內維持較高利率。
即使美國財政部將一項長天期公債回購計畫的規模擴大至原先的3倍，債券市場賣壓仍未消退。
不過，TS Lombard經濟學家Freya Beamish與Davide Oneglia在近日的報告中指出，目前殖利率上升仍不足以擊垮股市。他們寫道：「殖利率上升目前還不是股市的殺手。」
Beamish和Oneglia認為，近期殖利率上升並非由通常會終結多頭行情的經濟過熱所推動。相反地，他們認為，這波殖利率走高是對供給衝擊以及美國公債市場變化的反映。
股市之所以仍展現韌性，其中一項原因是人工智慧（AI）支出熱潮。Beamish和Oneglia表示，企業仍持續投入大量資金建置資料中心與AI基礎設施，形成投資與需求持續成長的循環。
兩人寫道：「當科技企業仍在追逐『無限需求』的概念時，僅靠幾個基點的變化，很難讓它們放慢腳步。」
更長期來看，關鍵問題在於，這些投資是否會擴散至科技業以外。目前，這些需求有很大一部分仍來自科技產業內部。
如果科技業以外的企業沒有開始增加AI支出，或者領先的AI模型失去競爭優勢，那麼經濟成長最終可能放緩，即使是超大規模雲端業者也不例外。
這些經濟學家表示，投資人應將目光放在利率以外，並更加關注企業的借貸規模。
Beamish和Oneglia寫道：「我們將關注信貸與槓桿的累積，而這似乎幾乎不可避免地最終會超出合理水準，尤其是在目前這個聯準會之下。」
他們並補充指出，聯準會主席華許（Kevin Warsh）已展現出必要時升息的意願。
TS Lombard表示，並不存在一個會「自動觸發股市拋售」的特定的美國公債殖利率水準。
不過，該公司的經濟學家認為，在當前環境下，10年期美債殖利率「應至少達到5%」，並警告，隨著債券殖利率維持高檔，股票將愈來愈難以合理化其投資價值。
paras_en: U.S. Treasury yields have kept climbing, reaching levels that typically pressure equities, yet so far they have not reversed the bullish trend in U.S. stocks. TS Lombard economists say the recent rise in yields stems from different forces than the overheating that once ended a bull market, so it is not yet a fatal threat to equities.
According to Business Insider, the benchmark 10‑year Treasury yield rose to 4.96% on Friday the 11th, reflecting continued selling pressure in the bond market.

The bond‑selling pressure has persisted for months, driven by higher oil prices, sticky inflation, massive government borrowing, and market expectations that the Federal Reserve will keep rates elevated for an extended period.
Even after the U.S. Treasury expanded a long‑term bond buy‑back program to three times its original size, the selling pressure in the bond market has not eased.

Nevertheless, TS Lombard economists Freya Beamish and Davide Oneglia noted in a recent report that the current yield rise is still insufficient to crush the stock market. They wrote: “Yield increases are not yet a killer for equities.”

Beamish and Oneglia argue that the recent yield rise is not driven by the kind of economic overheating that typically ends a bull market. Instead, they see it as a response to supply shocks and changes in the U.S. Treasury market.

One reason the equity market remains resilient is the AI spending boom. Beamish and Oneglia say companies continue to pour money into data centers and AI infrastructure, creating a virtuous cycle of investment and demand growth.
They wrote: “When tech firms are still chasing the idea of ‘infinite demand,’ a few basis points of change are unlikely to slow them down.”

Looking further ahead, the key question is whether these investments will spread beyond the tech sector. At present, a large share of the demand still originates within the technology industry itself.
If firms outside tech do not start increasing AI spend, or if leading AI models lose their competitive edge, economic growth could eventually slow—even for the biggest cloud providers.
The economists say investors should look beyond interest rates and pay closer attention to corporate borrowing levels.
Beamish and Oneglia wrote: “We will watch the accumulation of credit and leverage, which seems almost inevitably poised to exceed reasonable levels, especially under the current Fed environment.”
They added that Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh has shown a willingness to raise rates further if needed.
TS Lombard says there is no specific Treasury yield level that would automatically trigger a stock‑market sell‑off.

However, the firm’s economists believe that in the current environment the 10‑year Treasury yield “should at least reach 5%,” warning that as bond yields stay high, it will become increasingly difficult for stocks to justify their valuation.

items.title: 美債殖利率逼近5%不等於美股崩盤！高盛點出「多頭關鍵」
paras: 華爾街近期籠罩在「高利率恐慌」之中，30年期美國公債殖利率升至5.3%，接近近20年高點，10年期殖利率也逼近5%。然而，高盛認為，殖利率走高雖會對股市估值形成壓力，卻不代表美股多頭行情將因此終結，真正決定股市走勢的關鍵仍在企業獲利。
高盛在近日報告指出，高利率確實是股市的逆風，但只要企業獲利持續成長、資產負債表維持健康，美股仍具備延續多頭行情的基礎。
目前標普500指數遠期本益比已從年初約22倍降至19倍，反映AI相關不確定性、投資人對近期強勁獲利能否延續的疑慮，以及利率走高帶來的估值壓力。
不過，高盛指出，股市相對債券的吸引力並未明顯惡化，股票風險溢酬仍維持約3%。
高盛認為，這代表利率走高雖壓低股票絕對估值，卻尚未破壞股票相對債券的配置價值，因此目前仍不足以構成美股多頭反轉的充分理由。

高利率是逆風　但歷史顯示美股未必因此下跌

近期美國長天期公債殖利率快速攀升，10年期殖利率升至接近5%，30年期殖利率則達5.3%，接近近20年高點。高盛經濟學家預期，在通膨數據高於預期後，聯準會下週FOMC會議將升息25個基點。
高盛利率策略團隊認為，油價上漲、聯準會升息路徑重新定價、經濟維持強勁成長，以及AI投資熱潮，都是推升長天期殖利率的重要因素。
不過，高盛指出，市場目前已提前反映部分未來升息預期，利率市場已消化截至2027年年中前超過3次25個基點升息的預期。這在某種程度上抬高了政策進一步超預期收緊的門檻，降低了市場被「鷹派意外」衝擊的風險。
從歷史經驗來看，升息初期股市確實容易承壓，但中期表現未必悲觀。高盛統計過去數十年7次升息週期發現，聯準會啟動升息後3個月，標普500平均報酬率為負2%，僅29%機率取得正報酬；但拉長至12個月後，平均報酬率則達9%，除了2022年之外，其餘週期均錄得正報酬。
1997年便曾出現類似情況。當時聯準會僅升息25個基點，標普500隨即下跌10%，但在市場停止反映進一步緊縮後，股市觸底反彈，並在3個月內創下新高。
因此，高盛認為，升息對股市中期表現的影響，最終仍取決於貨幣緊縮是否開始傷害企業獲利成長。
高盛預估，2026年標普500每股盈餘（EPS）將達340美元，年增24%；2027年進一步升至385美元，年增13%。

長天期利率是估值關鍵　利率波動同樣值得留意

高盛指出，股票價格本質上反映企業未來現金流的折現價值，因此對長天期利率變化特別敏感。
根據高盛股息折現模型（DDM），標普500目前約75%至80%的現值來自10年以上的遠期現金流，也就是終值，因此長天期公債殖利率的變化對股市估值影響尤其明顯，與30年期美債殖利率的相關性也最強。
此外，高盛提醒，市場不能只關注殖利率「升到多少」，還要留意殖利率「升得多快」。
歷史資料顯示，當利率波動超過2個標準差時，股市通常較難消化。以目前10年期美債殖利率而言，2個標準差約相當於單月上升40至50個基點。近期殖利率快速走高，也因此成為股市承壓的重要因素之一。

大型企業財務體質強　高利率衝擊相對有限

高盛分析顯示，目前標普500企業整體具備相對強健的資產負債表，因此對利率上升的抵禦能力仍然較高。
首先，多數標普500企業的債務以固定利率、長天期借款為主，因此借貸成本不會立即受到利率上升全面衝擊。
其次，標普500企業整體利息保障倍數處於過去20年的第99百分位，中位數企業也位於第68百分位，顯示企業目前支付利息的能力仍處於歷史相對高檔。
不過，高盛也指出，中小型企業的財務體質相對脆弱，浮動利率債務占比較高，因此對利率上升的敏感度也更大。

AI投資、併購成企業提升獲利的重要手段

在高利率環境下，企業若要維持估值，必須透過更強的獲利成長抵銷資金成本上升帶來的壓力。高盛模型估算，若股權資金成本上升1個百分點，企業需要將長期成長預期提高2個百分點，才能完全抵銷利率上升對估值造成的影響。
因此，高盛認為，企業可能透過增加資本支出與研發、併購，以及分拆非核心業務等方式，改善未來獲利成長。
其中，AI投資仍是企業提高生產力與尋找新收入來源的重要方向。高盛指出，本季財報季約有一半標普500企業在業績說明會中提及採用AI以提高生產力，另有部分企業計畫利用AI拓展新的收入來源。
同時，美國今年以來已宣布的併購交易規模達1.4兆美元，全球併購量則年增36%。高盛認為，併購可成為企業快速改善成長軌跡的方式。
此外，企業也可能透過分拆業務，剝離低成長或非核心資產，以改善整體成長表現。

items.title: AI三巨頭齊喊先進模型研發「降速」！ 分析師：「這族群」周一恐先跌為敬 但長期影響有限
items.title_en: AI’s Three Titans Call for Slowing Advanced Model Development! Analysts Warn the Sector May Drop on Monday, Yet Long‑Term Impact Is Limited
paras: 周末期間，AI先進模型研發「降速」呼聲升溫，晶片與算力供應鏈短線承壓，但機構普遍認為，長期AI資本開支邏輯未破。
Anthropic執行長Dario Amodei上週六(12日)發文呼籲業界放慢最先進模型開發，並引入獨立第三方評估等額外安全措施；OpenAI執行長奧特曼表態支持，xAI的馬斯克亦稱「Dario是對的」。
市場擔心「限速」會影響大模型訓練量與相關獲利，半導體、伺服器、電力及雲端基礎設施股票今(14)日恐率先遭遇賣壓。
不過，Allspring Global Investments駐新加坡組合經理Gary Tan認為，AI仍處相對早期，生態其他環節未必同步減速，「短期會造成一些壓力，但不太可能破壞長期的AI交易」。當前晶片、能源與算力需求仍超供應，任何疲軟更可能被視為暫時回檔。
近期科技股表現分化，那斯達克100指數較6月歷史高點回落逾4%，美國晶片股跌約14%，亞洲科技股跌近8%，標普500與MSCI全球股票指數同期僅微漲約0.6%。
雖然高估值AI概念對「支出增加、回報放緩」訊號敏感，任一安全審查或排產延後都可能放大賣壓，但Global X Management投資策略師Billy Leung指出，Anthropic、OpenAI與xAI三位執行長同意降速，並不等於削減晶片、電力與資料中心支出，反而可能拉長部署週期。若商業化與應用端持續增長，企業可從「砸錢研發新模型」轉向「活化已建算力變現」，改善投資報酬率。
分析師指出，安全監管強化短期擾動情緒，但算力瓶頸、能源配對與長期AI滲透仍支撐基礎建設需求。對投資人而言，重點不在「是否繼續投AI」，而在模型迭代節奏、訂單能見度與已建資料中心利用率能否匹配高昂資本開支。
paras_en: During the weekend, calls to slow down the development of advanced AI models grew louder, putting short‑term pressure on chip and compute supply chains, but most institutions believe the long‑term AI capital‑expenditure logic remains intact.

Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei posted on Saturday (the 12th) urging the industry to slow the development of the most advanced models and to introduce independent third‑party safety assessments; OpenAI CEO Sam Altman voiced support, and xAI’s Elon Musk also said “Dario is right.”

The market worries that a “speed‑limit” could curb large‑model training volumes and related profits, so semiconductor, server, power and cloud‑infrastructure stocks may face the first wave of selling today (the 14th).

However, Allspring Global Investments’ Singapore‑based portfolio manager Gary Tan believes AI is still relatively early and other parts of the ecosystem may not slow down in sync, saying “there will be some short‑term pressure, but it’s unlikely to derail long‑term AI trades.” Current chip, energy and compute demand still outstrips supply, so any weakness is more likely to be seen as a temporary pullback.

Recent tech‑stock performance has diverged: the Nasdaq‑100 has fallen more than 4% from its June peak, U.S. chip stocks are down about 14%, Asian tech stocks are down nearly 8%, while the S&P 500 and MSCI World indices have barely risen about 0.6% over the same period.

Although high‑valuation AI concepts are sensitive to signals of “higher spending, slower returns,” any safety review or production delay could amplify selling pressure, but Global X Management strategist Billy Leung notes that the three CEOs’ agreement to slow down does not mean cutting chip, power or data‑center spending; it may actually lengthen deployment cycles. If commercialization and use‑case growth continue, companies can shift from “spending heavily on new model R&D” to “monetizing existing compute,” improving investment returns.

Analysts say tighter safety regulation creates short‑term sentiment turbulence, but compute bottlenecks, energy matching and the long‑term penetration of AI continue to underpin infrastructure demand. For investors, the focus is less on “whether to keep investing in AI” and more on the pace of model iteration, order visibility and whether the utilization of existing data‑centers can match the hefty capital outlays.

items.title: 「AI股神」捲土重來！Situational Awareness重押「這幾股」、3.15億美元看漲期權進場
paras: 曾因人工智慧（AI）交易一度聲名大噪的Situational Awareness基金，在7月經歷鉅額虧損、削減槓桿並出售大部分公開市場部位後，如今重新進場。
根據《金融時報》報導，Situational Awareness創辦人Leopold Aschenbrenner近期開始在超微半導體(AMD-US) 、英特爾(INTC-US) 、SK海力士(SKHY-US) 、SanDisk (SNDKV-US) 及AI新創CoreWeave(CRWV-US) 等科技股重新建立大額交易部位，且此次主要透過彈性看漲期權（Flex Call）操作。
知情人士透露，由於先前合作的經紀商關係幾乎全部中斷，Aschenbrenner此次轉而與專業經紀商Clear Street合作，重新建立市場交易管道。
這波操作之所以受到市場關注，在於其投資標的及交易方式，與7月造成鉅額虧損的策略具有高度相似性。

超微半導體、CoreWeave等AI股出現大額看漲期權交易

野村證券策略師Charlie McElligott此前已注意到市場中的異常交易。他指出，上週五（4日）及美國勞工節假期後的週二（8日），多檔AI與半導體相關個股出現大規模彈性看漲期權交易。
相關交易合計支付約3.15億美元期權權利金，涉及約11億美元Delta敞口及580萬美元Vega敞口。市場同時出現現貨價格與波動率同步上升的情況，與7月市場動盪前的交易特徵相似。
知情人士透露，Situational Awareness近期建立的新部位均透過彈性期權完成，部分標的正是先前基金遭遇鉅額虧損時持有的核心股票。
根據McElligott整理的野村交易台數據：

超微半導體(AMD-US) ：週五成交5000張2026年1月到期、行使價540.01美元的看漲期權，權利金約1870萬美元；週二再買進3700張行使價580.01美元的合約，權利金約1750萬美元。
布魯姆能源(BE-US) ：兩個交易日累計支付約4820萬美元期權權利金，同期股價累計上漲17.5%。
CoreWeave(CRWV-US) ：兩日股價累計上漲18%，相關期權權利金超過4300萬美元。
SK海力士(SKHY-US) 、SanDisk Corp(SNDKV-US) 、DRAM ETF(DRAM-US) 相關標的及英特爾(INTC-US) ：同樣出現大額、深度價外看漲期權交易。


這些交易主要集中在深度價外期權，相關策略意在利用Gamma效應放大股價動能，進一步推動標的價格上行。

7月鉅額虧損後　基金重新布局公開市場

Situational Awareness過去因押注AI熱潮受到市場矚目，創辦人Aschenbrenner也因此成為備受關注的科技投資人。
不過，今年夏季AI類股大幅回檔，導致基金遭遇數百億美元規模的虧損，並被迫大幅降低槓桿、出售大量持股。
為因應危機，Situational Awareness將旗下大部分公開市場部位出售給Citadel。這項交易讓基金得以維持運作，但也代表此前高度積極的交易策略告一段落。
Aschenbrenner在7月底致投資人的信中表示，基金將「另謀再戰之日」，並承諾從此前的經歷中吸取必要教訓。他當時也表示，基金未來將維持「公私混合」模式，但公開市場投資將採取「全額支付」方式管理。

改用全額支付期權　降低爆倉風險

與7月主要透過高盛等大型投行的總收益互換（TRS）取得高槓桿不同，Aschenbrenner此次重新進場改採彈性期權。
《金融時報》引述知情人士指出，全額支付期權（fully-paid options）的最大潛在損失理論上僅限於已支付的期權權利金，因此可避免過去高槓桿交易可能面臨的追加保證金及爆倉風險。
不過，交易工具改變並未完全改變原有的投資邏輯。此次交易仍集中在流動性相對有限、股價動能強勁的標的，透過建立大額部位押注股價進一步上漲。
McElligott指出，近期部分科技股劇烈波動後，市場再次出現現貨價格上升與隱含波動率同步走高的情況，這種關聯性正重新成為波動率分散策略的正向驅動因素。
7月的鉅額虧損也使Situational Awareness與華爾街金融機構的關係受到影響。據報導，先前與該基金合作的經紀商均遭美國司法部調查，使Aschenbrenner難以繼續透過主流金融機構進行交易。
在此背景下，他轉向Clear Street作為新的經紀商合作夥伴。對Aschenbrenner而言，這也代表他正試圖重新建立華爾街交易關係，並在此前鉅額虧損後重新布局。

重押AI股能否奏效　市場聚焦第二輪風險

Situational Awareness重新建立部位後，市場關注焦點也轉向這套交易策略能否再次奏效，以及是否可能重演7月的虧損。
此次採用全額支付期權後，交易的盈虧將由基金自行承擔，不再透過總收益互換與經紀商共同承擔風險敞口。若標的股價未能按照預期上漲，基金支付的期權權利金可能全部損失，且無法透過調整槓桿降低損失。
與此同時，AI及記憶體相關股票的波動仍受到市場關注。McElligott指出，這批高度集中於AI題材的股票在經歷夏季劇烈回檔後，波動率結構依然敏感，若股價動能中斷，可能迅速引發部位調整。
對於依賴深度價外期權及Gamma效應推動價格動能的交易策略而言，市場持續跟進是重要條件。一旦市場參與者開始針對高度集中的部位進行避險或建立反向交易，股價走勢可能與原先預期出現明顯差異。

items.title: AI交易週一恐遭「暴擊」？三巨頭支持放慢AI開發真是因「安全」還是「燒不起錢了」？
items.title_en: Will AI Trading Face a "Knockout" on Monday? Are the Three Giants Supporting Slower AI Development Really About "Safety" or "Running Out of Money"?
paras: Anthropic執行長Dario Amodei倡議放慢尖端AI模型開發腳步，獲得OpenAI執行長Sam Altman與馬斯克響應，市場隨即出現震盪。HyperliquidX平台數據顯示，OpenAI與Anthropic相關資產應聲下挫7%及2.8%，社群更傳出AI概念股週一（14日）開盤可能面臨逾10%的跌幅。不過，也有市場人士認為，「AI降速」未必代表需求轉弱，反而可能成為AI業者調整鉅額基礎設施投資、重新管理市場成長預期的策略。
Anthropic執行長Dario Amodei週六（12日）發文，呼籲全球AI產業主動降低尖端模型開發速度，隨後獲得馬斯克與OpenAI執行長Sam Altman公開支持。
Altman另向《Fortune》表示，OpenAI今年不會推進首次公開募股（IPO）計畫，並指出在目前的安全形勢下，此時上市並不「明智」。
這項罕見的「AI降速」訊息立即衝擊市場情緒。早期交易數據顯示，HyperliquidX平台相關資產在消息傳出後走低，OpenAI與Anthropic相關資產跌幅分別達7%與2.8%。
市場人士也開始評估消息對AI供應鏈的潛在影響，多名投資人透過社群平台警告，輝達(NVDA-US) 、博通(AVGO-US) 、超微半導體(AMD-US) 等AI概念股可能在周一面臨賣壓。
X平台科技投資人Jason更直指，AI股票週一早盤可能下跌逾10%，並認為Amodei的文章可能動搖目前市場追捧的「AI交易」。

AI支出成長預期恐遭重新評估

市場目前擔憂的核心，在於AI相關股票的高估值與龐大資本支出，部分建立在AI模型能力持續快速提升、企業持續增加AI投資的預期之上。
X用戶preetkailon指出，如果尖端AI開發速度真的開始放緩，投資人勢必重新檢視目前的市場定價邏輯。他並建議密切關注輝達、超微半導體及邁威爾科技(MRVL-US) 等AI相關企業的股價表現，並警告投資人不宜在當前環境下盲目追高。
不過，AI模型開發放慢是否意味著算力需求也會同步降溫，市場仍存在不同看法。
X用戶The AI Investor認為，目前AI模型已具備足夠的生產力，仍能帶動大量推理運算需求。
他指出，即使模型開發速度下降，對算力需求的實際影響可能有限，短期衝擊反而更可能來自市場情緒與恐慌，而非AI相關企業的實際業務。

AI降速與IPO高估值形成矛盾

此次事件另一個受到市場關注的焦點，是OpenAI暫不推進IPO。
《CNBC》記者Deirdre Bosa認為，這項決定並不令人意外。她指出，當OpenAI與Anthropic開始承認商業壓力可能促使AI企業過快推進模型開發時，這些企業要在公開市場同時維持高成長敘事，將變得更加困難。
上市後，公司除了必須面對投資人的成長要求，還要定期公布財務數據，股價也會隨市場預期持續波動。在這種環境下，要向股東說明「公司需要放慢成長」，顯然不是容易建立的投資故事。
Bosa指出，雖然AI安全開發可能比追求最大化財富創造更重要，但相關企業目前的高額私募估值、資金需求及投資人對鉅額回報的期待，都建立在AI能力持續快速推進的基礎上。
至於Amodei所說的「降速」究竟代表放慢整體業務成長，還是放緩尖端模型訓練，Bosa認為，這兩者對估值的影響並不相同。由於相關企業的估值高度依賴尖端技術持續突破，在開源權重模型持續追趕的競爭環境下，若放慢尖端模型開發，可能直接衝擊支撐高估值的核心邏輯。

安全考量之外，也牽動資本支出

市場對此次Anthropic、OpenAI及馬斯克公開支持「AI降速」的罕見局面，也出現另一種解讀，即企業可能同時面臨安全與商業層面的考量。
X用戶Jason Choi指出，Anthropic過去便經常公開談論AI安全問題，但此次選擇提出更具體的降速主張，時間點本身值得市場關注。
從企業利益來看，放慢尖端模型開發代表競爭對手可能獲得更多追趕時間，對高度依賴技術領先維持估值的企業而言，並非沒有代價。
因此，三方罕見地同時支持降速，也引發市場對其商業意圖的討論。
其中一種看法是，此舉可能具有管理IPO預期的作用，同時替未來調整資本支出留下空間。在AI基礎設施投資規模持續擴大的情況下，以安全為由放慢開發腳步，也可能讓高估值AI新創降低持續燒錢的財務壓力，因為「我們是為了安全主動放緩」，遠比「我們燒不起錢了」更容易被市場接受。
分析指出，對市場而言，真正需要觀察的問題因此不只是AI是否「降速」，而是這項轉變究竟代表AI產業發展出現實質拐點，抑或是企業正在重新塑造市場對AI成長與資本支出的預期。
週一，相關AI股票的市場反應，將成為短期重要觀察指標。
paras_en: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei called for a slowdown in cutting‑edge AI model development, drawing public support from OpenAI CEO Sam Altman and Elon Musk, which immediately rattled the market. Data from the HyperliquidX platform showed assets linked to OpenAI and Anthropic fell 7% and 2.8% respectively, and community chatter warned AI‑themed stocks could see drops of over 10% at Monday’s (the 14th) open. However, some market participants argue that a "AI slowdown" does not necessarily signal weakening demand; instead it may be a strategy for AI firms to trim massive infrastructure spending and reset growth expectations.

Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei posted on Saturday (the 12th) urging the global AI industry to voluntarily reduce the pace of advanced model development, a plea that was subsequently backed publicly by Musk and OpenAI CEO Sam Altman.
Altman also told Fortune that OpenAI will not pursue an initial public offering this year and noted that, given the current safety landscape, going public now would not be "wise".

The rare "AI slowdown" news instantly hit market sentiment. Early trading data showed that assets tied to OpenAI and Anthropic on the HyperliquidX platform slipped, with declines of 7% and 2.8% respectively after the news broke.

Market observers began assessing the potential impact on the AI supply chain, with several investors warning on social platforms that AI‑related stocks such as Nvidia (NVDA‑US), Broadcom (AVGO‑US) and AMD (AMD‑US) could face selling pressure on Monday.
Tech investor Jason on X bluntly predicted AI stocks could fall more than 10% in early Monday trading and suggested Amodei’s article might shake the current market hype around "AI trading".

AI spending growth expectations may be reassessed
The core market concern now centers on the lofty valuations and massive capex of AI‑related stocks, many of which are predicated on expectations of continuously rapid model improvements and ever‑increasing corporate AI investment.

X user preetkailon noted that if the pace of cutting‑edge AI development truly slows, investors will have to revisit the current pricing logic. He advised closely watching the stock performance of Nvidia, AMD and Marvell Technology (MRVL‑US) and warned against blindly buying high in the current environment.
However, whether a slowdown in model development also means a cooling of compute demand remains debated.
X user The AI Investor believes that current AI models already have sufficient productivity to drive substantial inference workloads.

He pointed out that even if model development slows, the real impact on compute demand may be limited; short‑term shocks are more likely to stem from market sentiment and panic rather than the actual business performance of AI firms.

AI slowdown clashes with IPO overvaluation
Another market focus of the episode is OpenAI’s decision to pause its IPO plans.

CNBC reporter Deirdre Bosa said the move was not surprising. She noted that as OpenAI and Anthropic begin to acknowledge commercial pressures that could push AI firms to rush model development, maintaining a high‑growth narrative in the public markets will become increasingly difficult.

Once public, a company must meet investors’ growth expectations, regularly disclose financials, and see its share price fluctuate with market sentiment. In that setting, telling shareholders that "the company needs to slow growth" is not an easy investment story to sell.

Bosa added that while safety‑first development may be more important than maximizing wealth creation, the high private‑valuation, funding needs, and investor expectations for massive returns of these firms are built on the premise of rapid AI capability advancement.

Regarding what Amodei’s "slowdown" actually means—whether it’s a deceleration of overall business growth or just a pause in cutting‑edge model training—Bosa believes the valuation impact differs. Because valuations heavily rely on continual breakthroughs in frontier tech, a slowdown in model development could directly undermine the core logic supporting lofty valuations in a competitive race to catch up with open‑weight models.

Beyond safety, capital spending is also at stake
The market’s reaction to the rare joint endorsement of an "AI slowdown" by Anthropic, OpenAI and Musk has sparked another interpretation: firms may be facing both safety and commercial considerations.
X user Jason Choi pointed out that Anthropic has long spoken publicly about AI safety, but this time it offered a concrete slowdown proposal, a timing that itself warrants market attention.

From a corporate perspective, slowing frontier model development gives competitors more time to catch up, which is not without cost for companies whose valuations depend heavily on technological leadership.
Thus, the three parties’ unusual simultaneous support for a slowdown has sparked debate over their commercial motives.

One view is that the move may help manage IPO expectations while leaving room to adjust future capital spending. In an environment of ever‑growing AI infrastructure investment, citing safety to slow development could also ease the financial pressure of continuously burning cash for high‑valuation AI startups, because "we are slowing down for safety" is far more market‑friendly than "we can’t afford to keep burning cash".

Analysts note that the market should watch not just whether AI is "slowing down" but whether this shift signals a substantive turning point for the industry or simply a reshaping of expectations around AI growth and capital expenditure.
On Monday, the market reaction of AI‑related stocks will serve as a key short‑term indicator.

items.title: 本週操盤筆記：超級央行週來了！Fed、日銀升息箭在弦上 美股、美債繃緊神經
items.title_en: This Week's Trading Notes: The Super Central Bank Week Is Here! Fed and BOJ Rate Hikes Loom, US Stocks and Bonds on Edge
paras: 全球市場本週將迎來央行超級週，聯準會(Fed)、日本銀行(BOJ)及英國央行(BOE)將接連公布利率決策。其中，美國通膨與就業數據雙雙偏強，使Fed升息1碼(25個基點)機率突破八成；日銀也可能將利率調升至1.25%。在美國10年期公債殖利率逼近5%、油價一度突破每桶100美元之際，央行是否釋出持續緊縮訊號，將左右美股、債市與匯市走勢。
標普500指數今年來在人工智慧(AI)基礎設施巨額投資及企業獲利成長帶動下，累計上漲近12%，但近期已較8月中旬歷史高點回落約2%。投資人除了關注全球利率走向，也將消化美國零售銷售、工業生產，以及英國、加拿大與日本通膨等重要數據。

Fed升息機率破八成 華許公信力迎來考驗

Fed將於週二至週三(15至16日)召開利率會議。新任Fed主席華許(Kevin Warsh)上月發表被市場視為偏鷹派的演說後，投資人便逐步提高9月升息押注。
上週公布的8月消費者物價指數(CPI)進一步強化升息預期，剔除食品與能源的核心CPI月增0.3%，高於市場預期。根據倫敦證券交易所集團(LSEG)資料，聯邦基金期貨顯示，Fed將利率區間由目前3.5%至3.75%調高1碼的機率已超過80%。
最新非農就業報告也顯示，美國8月新增16.2萬人，遠優於市場預期，加上Fed偏好的核心個人消費支出物價指數(Core PCE)年增率仍達3.3%，為升息提供更多理由。
BNY Wealth投資長Alicia Levine表示，目前市場預期已明顯倒向9月升息，但投資人真正關心的是，這次行動究竟只是單次調整，或代表Fed重啟一連串升息。若華許暗示抗通膨工作尚未完成，可能進一步推高美債殖利率並壓縮股票估值。
美國10年期公債殖利率上週五盤中一度升至4.99%，創近三年新高，終場報4.97%。一旦突破5%，債券對資金的吸引力將進一步提升，仰賴融資的小型股及高估值科技股恐首當其衝。

日銀升息幾成定局 日元與日本債市繃緊神經

Fed公布決策後，市場焦點將迅速轉向日銀週四至週五(17至18日)舉行的政策會議。市場幾乎已完全反映日銀升息1碼、將政策利率由1%調高至1.25%的可能性。
日銀7月雖選擇按兵不動，但已警告中東衝突推升能源價格、日元疲弱及AI相關需求強勁，可能使日本通膨超出預期。日銀總裁植田和男也表明，決策者將在9月會議討論是否升息，進一步強化市場預期。
《路透》調查顯示，經濟學家預估日銀在本月升息後，可能於明年3月底前將利率調高至1.5%，並在第二季進一步升至1.75%。因此，市場除關注日銀是否如期行動，也將從植田和男的記者會尋找後續升息速度及最終利率水準的線索。
日銀若釋出持續緊縮訊號，可能推升日元及日本公債殖利率，並促使部分日本資金撤出海外市場，對美債等全球債券帶來額外賣壓。反之，若植田態度偏向謹慎，日元可能再度承壓。

英國央行料按兵不動

英國央行將於週四(17日)公布利率決策。儘管能源價格上漲推升通膨風險，但《路透》調查的65名經濟學家預料，英國央行將把利率維持在3.75%，並可能至少按兵不動至2027年年中。
英國央行總裁貝利(Andrew Bailey)日前也淡化升息勢在必行的說法，強調政策仍取決於經濟與地緣政治情勢。市場將觀察決策聲明是否提及油價上漲可能造成的第二輪通膨效應，以及英國央行內部支持升息的聲音是否增加。

經濟數據與油價左右市場

數據方面，美國將公布8月零售銷售及工業生產，檢驗消費與製造業動能。如果數據持續強勁，可能進一步支持Fed升息；若明顯轉弱，則將加深市場對高利率打擊經濟的疑慮。英國、加拿大與日本通膨數據也將接連登場。
油價與美伊局勢則是央行無法忽視的變數。原油價格近期一度突破每桶100美元，市場擔憂能源成本將使全球通膨更難降溫。道富銀行(State Street)宏觀多資產策略師Cayla Seder表示，殖利率上升、升息預期升溫與地緣政治風險交錯，市場仍處於高度不確定期。
不過，花旗財富管理(Citi Wealth)投資組合策略主管JP Coviello認為，美債殖利率走高部分源於經濟成長預期改善，加上企業獲利仍然強勁，基本面暫時足以支撐股市。美股能否延續今年漲勢，將取決於全球央行本週究竟只是個別調整政策，還是共同揭開新一輪緊縮序幕。
paras_en: Global markets this week will enter a super central‑bank week as the Federal Reserve, Bank of Japan and Bank of England are set to announce rate decisions. Strong US inflation and employment data have pushed the probability of a 25‑basis‑point Fed hike above 80%, and the BOJ may raise its rate to 1.25%. With the US 10‑year Treasury yield nearing 5% and oil briefly topping $100 a barrel, whether central banks signal continued tightening will steer equities, bonds and currencies.

The S&P 500 has risen almost 12% year‑to‑date on massive AI‑related infrastructure spending and corporate earnings growth, but it has slipped about 2% from its mid‑August peak. Investors are watching global rate trends while also digesting US retail sales, industrial production and inflation data from the UK, Canada and Japan.
This week’s trading notes (Sept 14‑18)

Fed hike probability tops 80% – Warsh’s credibility under test
The Fed will meet on Tuesday‑Wednesday (Sept 15‑16). After new Fed chair Kevin Warsh delivered a speech last month that markets read as hawkish, investors have been steadily raising their September hike bets.

Last week’s August CPI reinforced the hike outlook, with core CPI (ex‑food and energy) up 0.3% month‑over‑month, above expectations. LSEG data show Fed‑funds futures price the odds of moving the policy band from 3.5‑3.75% to a higher 25‑bp range at over 80%.

The latest non‑farm payrolls also showed 162,000 jobs added in August, far beating forecasts, and the Fed‑preferred core PCE price index remains at a 3.3% annual rise, adding further support for a hike.

BNY Wealth chief investment officer Alicia Levine says the market now clearly expects a September hike, but investors are really wondering whether this will be a one‑off move or the start of a series of hikes. If Warsh signals that anti‑inflation work is unfinished, bond yields could climb further and equity valuations could be squeezed.

The US 10‑year Treasury yielded as high as 4.99% intraday last Friday, a near‑three‑year high, closing at 4.97%. A break above 5% would make bonds even more attractive, hitting small‑cap stocks and high‑multiple tech names hardest.

BOJ hike looks all but certain – yen and Japanese bond market on edge
After the Fed decision, focus will shift quickly to the BOJ’s policy meeting on Thursday‑Friday (Sept 17‑18). Markets have almost fully priced in a 25‑bp BOJ hike, moving the policy rate from 1.00% to 1.25%.

Although the BOJ left rates unchanged in July, it warned that Middle‑East conflict‑driven energy price spikes, a weak yen and strong AI demand could push Japanese inflation above expectations. Governor Kazuo Ueda also said policymakers will discuss a possible hike at the September meeting, reinforcing market expectations.

A Reuters poll shows economists think the BOJ could lift rates to 1.5% by the end of March 2025 and to 1.75% in the second quarter, so the market will watch Ueda’s press conference for clues on the pace and final level of future hikes.

If the BOJ signals continued tightening, the yen and Japanese gilt yields could rise, prompting some Japanese capital to flow out of overseas markets and adding selling pressure to global bonds such as US Treasuries. Conversely, a cautious stance from Ueda could keep yen pressure alive.

Bank of England likely to hold steady
The BoE will announce its decision on Thursday (Sept 17). Despite higher energy prices stoking inflation risks, a Reuters poll of 65 economists expects the BoE to keep rates at 3.75% and possibly stay on hold at least until mid‑2027.

BoE governor Andrew Bailey has recently downplayed the notion that another hike is inevitable, stressing that policy will depend on economic and geopolitical developments. Markets will watch whether the statement mentions a second‑round inflation effect from oil price gains and whether internal support for hikes is growing.

Data and oil prices drive markets
The US will release August retail sales and industrial production, testing consumer and manufacturing momentum. Strong data could further back a Fed hike; weaker numbers would deepen concerns that high rates could hurt the economy. Inflation figures from the UK, Canada and Japan are also due.

Oil prices and US‑Iran tensions are variables central banks cannot ignore. Crude briefly broke $100 a barrel, raising fears that energy costs will keep global inflation stubbornly high. State Street macro‑multi‑asset strategist Cayla Seder says rising yields, hotter rate‑hike expectations and geopolitical risk create a highly uncertain market environment.

However, Citi Wealth portfolio strategy head JP Coviello argues that higher US Treasury yields are partly driven by improved growth expectations and still‑strong corporate earnings, so fundamentals can currently support equities. Whether US stocks can keep their year‑to‑date rally will depend on whether this week’s central‑bank actions are isolated tweaks or the start of a broader tightening cycle.

items.title: 【美股焦點】AI基建成長重心已改變，Marvell邁威爾靠光學與客製化ASIC卡位受惠
items.title_en: US Stock Focus: AI Infrastructure Growth Focus Shifts, Marvell Positions to Benefit with Optics and Custom ASICs
paras: 2026年09月13日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 輝達Nvidia(NVDA-US)過去靠GPU效能的世代提升撐起AI硬體成長，但當單一運算叢集使用的加速器由數千顆增加至數萬顆，決定整體效能的已不只是單顆GPU運算力，而是晶片之間能否快速交換資料。大量GPU若因網路壅塞而等待，企業即使投入更多資本支出，也無法等比例增加有效算力。AI投資重心因此開始由運算晶片向高速互連擴散，這正是邁威爾Marvell Technology(MRVL-US)重新受到市場關注的原因。
銅線在高速、長距離傳輸下，面臨功耗增加與訊號衰減問題，資料中心連接正加速導入光通訊。邁威爾與博通Broadcom(AVGO-US)在光收發模組使用的PAM4數位訊號處理器(DSP)市場占據主要位置；隨著網路規格由800G升級至1.6T，單一模組的晶片價值量有望提高。不過，新產品能否同步改善毛利率，仍取決於量產良率、成本與市場競爭。
下一階段則是共同封裝光學(CPO)與矽光子。CPO將交換器晶片與光學元件放進同一封裝，縮短電訊號傳輸距離，藉此降低功耗與延遲。當AI叢集規模持續擴大，光通訊的價值不再只是提高傳輸速度，而是避免網路瓶頸拖累昂貴GPU的使用效率。
邁威爾的另一項成長來源是客製化ASIC與相關互連技術。亞馬遜Amazon(AMZN-US)的Trainium系列及谷歌母公司Alphabet(GOOGL-US)的自研加速器，都需要高速晶片互連、網路與光通訊解決方案。這代表超大規模雲端業者即使降低對輝達標準GPU架構的依賴，轉向自行設計加速器，邁威爾仍可能透過客製化晶片與互連產品取得商機。
因此不是邁威爾能否取代輝達，而是無論AI運算採用GPU或客製化ASIC，叢集規模擴大都需要更多高速互連。邁威爾成長來源橫跨光通訊、網路晶片與客製化ASIC，讓公司有機會同時參與不同AI運算架構的資本支出。

paras_en: On September 13, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – Nvidia (NVDA-US) has historically driven AI hardware growth through generational improvements in GPU performance, but as the number of accelerators used in a single compute cluster expands from a few thousand to tens of thousands, overall performance is no longer determined solely by the compute power of individual GPUs. It now depends on how quickly chips can exchange data with each other. If a large number of GPUs are forced to wait because of network congestion, companies cannot proportionally increase effective compute power even with higher capital expenditures. Consequently, AI investment focus is shifting from compute chips to high‑speed interconnects, which is why Marvell Technology (MRVL-US) has regained market attention.

Copper wiring faces increased power consumption and signal attenuation at high speeds and long distances, prompting data centers to accelerate the adoption of optical communications. Marvell and Broadcom (AVGO-US) dominate the market for PAM4 digital signal processors (DSPs) used in optical transceiver modules; as network specifications upgrade from 800 Gbps to 1.6 Tbps, the value per chip in a single module is expected to rise. However, whether the new products can simultaneously improve gross margins still depends on production yields, costs, and market competition.

The next stage involves Co‑Packaged Optics (CPO) and silicon photonics. CPO places the switch chip and optical components in the same package, shortening the electrical signal path and thereby reducing power consumption and latency. As AI cluster sizes continue to grow, the value of optical communication is no longer just about higher transmission speeds but about avoiding network bottlenecks that would drag down the utilization efficiency of expensive GPUs.

Another growth driver for Marvell is custom ASICs and related interconnect technologies. Amazon’s (AMZN-US) Trainium series and Alphabet’s (GOOGL-US) in‑house accelerators both require high‑speed chip interconnects, networking, and optical communication solutions. This means that even if hyperscale cloud providers reduce their reliance on Nvidia’s standard GPU architecture and move toward self‑designed accelerators, Marvell can still capture business through custom chips and interconnect products.

Thus, the question is not whether Marvell can replace Nvidia, but that regardless of whether AI workloads use GPUs or custom ASICs, larger clusters will need more high‑speed interconnects. Marvell’s growth sources span optical communications, networking chips, and custom ASICs, giving the company the opportunity to participate in capital spending across multiple AI compute architectures.
